summary: Review found seven blocking gaps in UI-design activation, routing, capability resolution, gate handling, and quality-pass resume safety.

findings.summary: Non-Pen sources have no activation path to create the saved design context required for UI-design routing.
findings.evidence: FR-005 requires Figma, image and text-only restyles to become UI design runs. Preflight activates and records design context only for a Pen implementation reference, while lines 92 and 117 require a Figma source or design context to have already been recorded. The text classifier at core/roles/spec-builder.md:44 records a field in that context but does not establish it.
findings.fix: Activate and persist design context for Figma, image and eligible text-only requests before plan, including references first discovered later; retain Pen-only capability resolution where appropriate.

findings.summary: Mixed-run routing conflicts with code-build's unchanged whole-task-list contract.
findings.evidence: FR-006 requires each contiguous run to be assigned to its designated role in tasks.md order. core/roles/code-build.md:28-31 directs code-build to follow the entire tasks.md and start at its first unfinished unit, and line 40 defines done as every box checked. A code-build spawn before a UI batch can implement that batch itself or cannot report done at its assigned boundary.
findings.fix: Pass an explicit assignment boundary to code-build and update its work and completion instructions to honor that boundary without changing ordinary non-design runs.

findings.summary: Implement has no relay and resume handling for ui-designer's protected questions.
findings.evidence: FR-017 and the missing-target edge case require ui-designer to return protected scope questions; core/roles/ui-designer.md:22 does so. The implement step handles partial returns but does not route needs_input through the relay or resume ui-designer after answers. protocol.md:109 explicitly respawns spec-builder, not the implement role.
findings.fix: Handle needs_input from implement roles through the protected relay and respawn the same assigned role with settled answers and unchanged task boundary.

findings.summary: Figma MCP-only installations cannot satisfy the required capability resolution.
findings.evidence: FR-008 requires resolving either a figma skill or MCP capability. verbs.md:11 defines RESOLVE only for skill or SpecKit files, and adapters/*/harness.md implement filesystem skill searches without MCP discovery. An available Figma MCP without a figma skill is treated as missing and blocks before tasks.
findings.fix: Define and implement a harness-neutral capability-discovery contract for Figma MCP, including its handoff to the role, while preserving existing skill resolution.

findings.summary: Text-only restyles cannot satisfy the implemented verified and done conditions.
findings.evidence: FR-015 requires text-only mapping and fidelity to be not_applicable with reason "no design reference". The mapping reference says only all passing gates set implementation status verified, while core/roles/ui-designer.md:27 requires design gates verified or an explicit scoped waiver for done.
findings.fix: Define verified and done in terms of all applicable gates passing plus valid source-specific not-applicable results, without requiring a waiver for text-only mapping and fidelity.

findings.summary: Quality-pass edits occur after gate verification and completed batch commits without a required commit or renewed design evidence.
findings.evidence: FR-023 requires current evidence and FR-024 runs ui-agent after the last UI task's gates pass. The role commits and checks each batch at line 24, then runs the quality pass at line 26, but does not require committing applied recommendations or rerunning invalidated mapping and rendered-fidelity gates.
findings.fix: Make applied quality changes part of a committed, tested unit and refresh all evidence invalidated by those changes before reporting completion.

findings.summary: Quality-pass completion marker is written only after execution, allowing a repeated pass on resume.
findings.evidence: FR-024 and SC-004 require ui-agent at most once per run, including resumes. The role checks ui_agent_pass, runs the pass, then persists its record. A deadline, crash or interruption after the pass starts but before persistence leaves the marker unset, so the fresh role runs the pass again.
findings.fix: Persist a durable pass reservation before invocation and define interruption and resume handling that preserves the at-most-once guarantee while reporting incomplete work.
